title: Propagation recovers a satisfying labeling
statement: Let $G$ be a finite unique game, and suppose a labeling of its vertices satisfies every constraint. Assign to each component root the label it has in this labeling, then propagate those root labels along the chosen paths. The resulting labeling is equal to the original labeling at every vertex.
hypotheses_covered: A finite unique game with finite nonempty vertex and constraint sets, distinct endpoints, and a permutation attached to each constraint
A labeling of every vertex by one of the $q$ labels
